I met Clayton and Haley Bowman, the couple behind Backyard Pizza, a family-run pizza tent in Cameron, Missouri, and I interviewed them about their business. They have already hit thousand dollar nights selling authentic wood-fired pizzas and they are proving how profitable this simple side hustle can be.

In this episode I show you how to copy this business idea, the same model a professor in California uses to make 175K a year just from weekends. There is even a guy in the UK running two trailers who makes thousands of dollars a day with this same concept. We talk about how the Bowmans started, what the margins look like, and what it takes to get going yourself.

You can follow their journey on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61575636747747

Enjoy!
